name: Eclipse 500 / EA500
summary: A tiny six-seat very light jet with two small turbofans, built in the hundreds before Eclipse Aviation collapsed in 2008 and a few later as the Eclipse 550.

wings: Low, slightly swept wing with rounded pods or tanks at the wingtips
engines: Two very small turbofans on short stubs on the rear fuselage sides
fuselage: Small oval windows and a short, rounded nose
tail: Swept fin with a low-set horizontal stabilizer that has noticeable dihedral (not a T-tail)

tellTales: A very small twin jet with bulbous rounded pods on its wingtips
Tiny engines sitting right against the rear fuselage
Short, stubby cabin with a low-set tailplane

confusedWith.howToTell: The Eclipse is shorter with a stubbier cabin and bulbous wingtip pods; the Mustang has a longer cabin, larger engine pods and plain wingtips.
The Phenom 100 has a T-tail and a much longer, larger cabin; the Eclipse has a low-set tailplane and wingtip pods.
The CitationJet is a bigger aircraft with a T-tail, long cabin and larger engines; the Eclipse is tiny with a low tailplane and wingtip pods.
The Vision Jet has a single engine mounted above its rear fuselage and a V-tail; the Eclipse has two engines on the sides and a conventional tail.

usCount.source: FAA Releasable Aircraft Database — valid registrations
